title: 2d Recon Helo Casting B-roll
description: U.S. Marines with Alpha Company, 2d Reconnaissance Battalion, 2d Marine Division helocast from a CH53E helicopter during a helocast training exercise on Camp Lejeune, North Carolina, Feb. 14, 2023. Helocasting is an airborne technique used by small unit, special operations forces to insert troops into a military area of operations. (U.S. Marine Corps photo by Lance Cpl. Ethan Robert Jones)
